entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. My VeloBand is a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
What kind of stupid question is that? It's broken! It's not working! It just flashes a red light and won't sync with my phone. I want a refund for this defective garbage.

Okay, I understand your frustration. A red flashing light and a sync issue is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can see here you received the VeloBand Pulse 13 days ago. For a technical issue like this, our first step is to connect you with our tech support team.
No! No 'technical support'! I'm not wasting another hour on the phone. This thing is brand new and it's broken. I want a refund. It's that simple. Put your manager on the phone right now!

I understand you'd prefer a refund, but my manager would confirm the same policy. Because you've had the device for 13 days, it's just outside our strict 10-day return window for the VeloBand Pulse. However, that doesn't mean you're stuck with a defective product. Your device is fully covered by our warranty.

This is unbelievable! I paid good money for a product that's not working right out of the box! I'm going to leave a review on every single website telling people how VeloFit sells broken junk and has terrible service!

I certainly don't want you to feel that way, and I want to get this solved for you. The fastest way to get a working device is through our technical support team. They can determine if the issue can be fixed remotely or if a replacement needs to be sent out immediately. They're the only department authorized to handle warranty replacements for something that won't sync.
...So they can just send me a new one?

Absolutely. If they confirm it's a hardware fault, they will process a warranty replacement for you right away. They are our experts on these technical issues. Would you like me to transfer you to them now? I can provide them with your information so you don't have to repeat everything.
(Sighs heavily) Fine. Whatever. Just get it done.
Of course. Please hold for one moment while I connect you. I've noted the issue is that the device is not working and won't sync. They'll take great care of you.
